question: What is adiabatic compression, and why can it set cotton on fire?
answer: Squeezing air heats it. Push the plunger slowly and the heat leaks away. Push it fast and the heat is trapped, hot enough to light the cotton on its own.
move: Adiabatic compression: so fast the heat has no time to escape.
